children.text: How to Play Powerball
To play, you'll choose five white ball numbers and one red Powerball number.
For each play, you'll make three simple choices: 1. Choose your numbers. 2. Decide if you want to add Power Play. 3. Decide if you want to add Double Play.
Each Powerball play costs $2.
Step 1: Choose Your Numbers
Choose: • 5 white ball numbers from 1 through 69 • 1 red Powerball number from 1 through 26
Or choose Easy Pick and let the computer randomly select your numbers for you.
Step 2: Add Power Play (Optional)
For an additional $1, you can add Power Play to your ticket.

Power Play multiplies most non-jackpot prizes by 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, or 10X. The multiplier is randomly selected before each drawing. The 10X multiplier is only in play when the jackpot amount is $150 million or less.
Power Play does not apply to the jackpot prize.
Step 3: Add Double Play (Optional)
For an additional $1, you can add Double Play.
Double Play enters your same numbers into a second drawing, giving you another chance to win using a separate prize structure.
Adding Double Play does not affect your original Powerball drawing.

Powerball drawings are held every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday. Powerball sales stop on draw days at 8:59 PM CST. You can also choose to play the same numbers up to ten (10) draws. You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim any prizes won. Once a ticket is expired, it cannot be redeemed for a prize.
Online sales end at 8:58pm and retail sales end at 8:59pm on draw days.
Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 24.87.
The jackpot prize may become pari-mutuel and will be divided equally among multiple jackpot winners.
10x multiplier in play when advertised jackpot is $150 million or less.
Power Play does not apply to Double Play.
How to Play Mega Millions
You will select five white ball numbers and one gold Mega Ball number. Each play costs $5. The built-in multiplier is included with every Mega Millions play at no additional cost.
Step 1: Choose Your Numbers
Choose: • 5 white ball numbers from 1 through 70 • 1 gold Mega Ball number from 1 through 24 Or choose Easy Pick and let the computer randomly select your numbers for you.
Step 2: Built-in Multiplier

Every Mega Millions ticket includes the multiplier automatically. A multiplier of 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, or 10X is randomly assigned to each play when your ticket is purchased. If you win a non-jackpot prize, your prize is multiplied by the number shown on your ticket. The multiplier does not apply to the jackpot prize.

Mega Millions drawings are held every Tuesday and Friday. Mega Millions sales stop on draw days at 8:59 PM CST. You can also choose to play the same numbers up to ten (10) draws. You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim any prizes won. Once a ticket is expired, it cannot be redeemed for a prize.
Online sales end at 8:58pm and retail sales end at 8:59pm on draw days.
Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 23.07.
The jackpot prize may become pari-mutuel and will be divided equally among multiple jackpot winners.

rules.title: Lotto America

children.text: How to Play Lotto America
You select five numbers and one Star Ball number. For each play, you'll make two simple choices: 1. Choose your numbers. 2. Decide if you want to add All Star Bonus. Each Lotto America play costs $1.
Step 1: Choose Your Numbers
Choose: • 5 numbers from 1 through 52 • 1 Star Ball number from 1 through 10 Or choose Easy Pick and let the computer randomly select your numbers for you.
Step 2: Add All Star Bonus (Optional)

For an additional $1, you can add All Star Bonus to your ticket. The All Star Bonus multiplies most non-grand prize winnings by 2X, 3X, 4X, or 5X. The multiplier is randomly selected before each drawing. The All Star Bonus does not apply to the grand prize.

Lotto America drawings are held every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday. Lotto America sales stop on draw days at 8:59 PM CST. You can also choose to play the same numbers up to ten (10) draws. You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim any prizes won. Once a ticket is expired, it cannot be redeemed for a prize.
Players have until 8:59pm on draw days to purchase Lotto America tickets.
Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 9.63.
The jackpot prize may become pari-mutuel. If there is more than one jackpot winner, the jackpot prize will be divided equally among all jackpot winners.

rules.title: Millionaire for Life

children.text: How to Play Millionaire for Life
You choose five numbers and one Millionaire Ball number. Each play costs $5.
Step 1: Choose Your Numbers
Choose: • 5 numbers from 1 through 58 • 1 Millionaire Ball number from 1 through 5 Or choose Easy Pick and let the computer randomly select your numbers for you.

Millionaire for Life drawings are held every day. Sales stop on draw days at 8:30 PM CST. You can also choose to play the same numbers up to ten (10) draws. You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim any prizes won. Once a ticket is expired, it cannot be redeemed for a prize.
Ticket sales will close no later than 9:15 pm CT.
Note:

Winner notifications may display the cash value of a prize rather than the annuity value. The final prize amount is determined when the prize is claimed based on the payment option selected and the Official Game Rules.
Overall Odds:
Cash Option Values
Match 5 + Millionaire Ball:
$$18,000,000 lump-sum cash payment.
Match 5:
$2,200,000 lump-sum cash payment.
Annuity Option
Players who win the top two prizes may choose either the Cash Option or the Annuity Option. This election is irrevocable and must be made within
60 days
of becoming entitled to the prize.
For individual winners, the annuity is paid over the winner's lifetime.
For claims made by a legal entity, multiple winners on the same ticket, a minor, or any group that includes a minor, "life" is defined as a fixed
20-year
payment period.
Prize Liability Limitations
In certain circumstances, prize payments may be adjusted as required by the Official Game Rules.
2–20 Grand Prize Winners
The $1,000,000-per-year-for-life annuity is divided equally among all Grand Prize winners.
The minimum annuity is
$$50,000 per year for life
Winners may instead choose the applicable lump-sum Cash Option.
21 or More Grand Prize Winners
No annuity option is available.
The available Grand Prize cash value is divided equally among all Grand Prize winners and paid as a one-time lump sum.
Each winning play will receive at least the value of the next lower prize tier.
21 or More Second Prize Winners
No annuity option is available.
The available Second Prize liability is divided equally among all Second Prize winners and paid as a one-time lump sum.
Each winning play will receive at least the value of the next lower prize tier.

Players who win the top two prize levels may choose to receive their prize as an annuity, with a minimum guaranteed payout over 20 years, or a one-time cash payment. The top prize is awarded on a pari-mutuel basis. In certain circumstances, prize payouts could change for pari-mutuel payouts.

rules.title: Pick 3

children.text: How to Play Pick 3
Pick 3 is a daily draw game where you choose three numbers from 0 through 9.
For each play, you'll make two simple choices: 1. Choose your numbers. 2. Choose how you want those numbers to match the winning numbers.
Each play cost $1.
Step 1: Choose Your Numbers
Choose any three numbers from 0 through 9, or choose Easy Pick and let the computer select them for you.
For this example, let's say you picked: 1 – 2 – 3
Now decide how you want to play those numbers.
Step 2: Choose Your Play Type
Your play type determines how your numbers have to match the winning numbers to win.
Straight
Your numbers must match exactly, in the same order. Your numbers: 1-2-3 ✅ 1-2-3 — WIN ❌ 3-2-1 — NO WIN ❌ 2-1-3 — NO WIN
Box

Your numbers can match in any order. As long as the winning numbers contain 1, 2 and 3, you win. Your numbers: 1-2-3 ✅ 1-2-3 — WIN ✅ 3-2-1 — WIN ✅ 2-3-1 — WIN ✅ 1-3-2 — WIN ✅ 3-1-2 — WIN ✅ 2-1-3 — WIN
If your numbers include a duplicate (like 1-1-3), there are only three possible winning orders instead of six.
Front Pair
Only the first two numbers have to match. The last number can be anything. Your numbers: 1-2-3 ✅ 1-2-5 — WIN ✅ 1-2-8 — WIN ✅ 1-2-3 — WIN ❌ 3-2-1 — NO WIN ❌ 5-2-3 — NO WIN
Back Pair

Only the last two numbers have to match. The first number can be anything. Your numbers: 1-2-3 ✅ 5-2-3 — WIN ✅ 8-2-3 — WIN ✅ 1-2-3 — WIN ❌ 3-2-1 — NO WIN ❌ 1-3-2 — NO WIN Pick 3 sales stop on draw dates at 8:59PM CST.
You can also choose to play the same numbers up to seven (7) draws.
You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim any prizes won. Once a ticket is expired, it cannot be redeemed for a prize.

Pick 3 drawings are held at approximately 1:10pm and 9:10pm seven days a week. You have until 12:59pm to purchase tickets for the Midday drawing. You have until 8:59pm to purchase tickets for the Evening drawing.
Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 8.47.
How to Play Cash 5
You choose five numbers. Each play costs $1.
Step 1: Choose Your Numbers
Choose 5 numbers from 1 through 36. Or choose Easy Pick and let the computer randomly select your numbers for you.

Cash 5 drawings are held every day. Sales stop on draw days at 8:59 PM CST. You can also choose to play the same numbers up to ten (10) draws. You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim any prizes won. Once a ticket is expired, it cannot be redeemed for a prize.

The top prize of $25,000 taxes paid is a fixed amount. The Oklahoma Lottery will pay all applicable Federal and State Tax withholdings. Winners will receive a prize of $25,000. In situations where there are more than five (5) winners for a single drawing, winners will equally split a pretax total of $200,000.
Players have until 8:59pm on draw days to purchase Cash 5 tickets.

rules.title: Powerball Xs & Os

children.text: How to Play Powerball Xs & Os
You choose 8 team logos from a field of 32 team logos. Each play costs $5.
Step 1: Choose Your Team Logos
Choose 8 different team logos from the available 32 team logos. Or choose Easy Pick and let the computer randomly select your team logos for you.

Powerball Xs & Os drawings are held every Sunday. Sales stop on draw days at 8:00 PM CST. You can also choose to play the same team logos up to ten (10) draws. You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim any prizes won. Once a ticket is expired, it cannot be redeemed for a prize.
Online sales end at 8:58pm and retail sales end at 8:59pm on draw days.
Overall Odds 1 in 12

Note: Winner notifications may display the cash value of the prize instead of the annuity value. The final amount paid will be determined at the time of claim based on the payment option selected by the player and in accordance with official game rules.
Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 8.47.
All prizes, including the Grand Prize, may need to be paid out as pari-mutuel prizes.
